_comment: smart_ac scheduler config -- copy to smart_ac.json, edit for your house, then sudo systemctl restart smart-ac
_rooms_comment: Room slugs match the input_boolean.ac_<slug> entities you create with setup_ac_input_booleans.py. Below are examples for a 6-AC house; substitute your own.
_day_min_comment: Which ACs are forced ON during the DAY period (between sunrise+morning_offset and sunset-evening_offset). Falls back to night_min_acs if unset. Set to [] to have NO baseline during the day -- lets the scheduler decide who runs based on day_priority alone. Useful if you want DEFICIT/CHARGE_BEHIND to turn EVERYTHING off (including bedrooms) so charging is maximised.
_day_priority_comment: Ordered list of DAY extras the scheduler considers, first-preferred first. In ON_TRACK mode, one extra is added if the corresponding room needs cooling. In SURPLUS mode, all needed extras are added.
_evening_comment: EVENING period = between effective_day_end (sun-based) and bedtime_hour. Family still up but solar gone. Target = evening_min_acs + evening_extra_required.
_occupancy_comment: Optional per-bedroom occupancy overlay. Map each bedroom slug to its input_boolean.bedroom_<room>_occupied helper (created by setup_bedroom_occupancy_helpers.py). At runtime the scheduler intersects night_min_acs and evening_min_acs against occupied rooms, so a bedroom whose toggle is OFF drops out of the always-cooled sets even though it's listed above. Rooms not present in this mapping are treated as implicitly occupied; omit the whole key to disable the feature entirely.
_occupancy_window_comment: Optional per-bedroom TIME-OF-DAY windows layered on top of the occupancy toggles above. A bedroom is only considered occupied when its toggle is ON AND the current local time is inside its [from, to) window. Windows can wrap midnight (from > to means overnight, e.g. 22:00 -> 07:00). Rooms without a window entry are considered always in-window. Omit this whole key to disable the feature; the setup_bedroom_occupancy_helpers.py script creates the input_datetime helpers with sensible bedroom-hour defaults.
_proxy_room_comment: Optional. Rooms without their own indoor sensor use this room's sensor as a stand-in, compared against comfort_target_f (or the per-room override below). Falls back to unsensored_assume_hot_above_outdoor_f + outdoor_sensor if the proxy is unavailable or unset. Set null / omit to keep the pure-outdoor-threshold behaviour.
_per_room_target_comment: Optional. Per-room comfort target override -- JSON fallback. Any room listed here uses its own value instead of comfort_target_f. Slider entities below take precedence at runtime.
_per_room_target_entity_comment: Optional. Live per-room comfort target sliders. Create via setup_comfort_target_helpers.py; the scheduler prefers these over comfort_target_for_room + comfort_target_f. Omit to disable slider-based control.
_unoccupied_comment: Classic no-one-home mode: relaxed targets, fewer ACs at once, daily rotation across priority to spread wear.
_vacation_comment: Stricter than unoccupied. Triggered by input_boolean.smart_ac_vacation_mode. Intended for extended absences where saving battery matters more than keeping the house cool.
_maintain_comment: Solar-first unoccupied mode. Triggered by input_boolean.smart_ac_maintain_mode ONLY while house_occupied=off (occupied wins if the house is occupied; vacation wins over maintain). Baselines are SoC-gated: evening room runs only if snap.soc > maintain_evening_min_soc, night room only if snap.soc > maintain_night_min_soc. DAY cooling still layers on via SURPLUS/ON_TRACK from maintain_day_priority, capped by maintain_max_acs_total. Use case: 'I'm away but I don't want the house to cook -- cool aggressively when solar allows, let the bank rest when it can't afford it.' See setup_smart_ac_maintain_helper.py to create the input_boolean.
_party_comment: Triggered by input_boolean.smart_ac_party_mode. Adds common-area ACs to the always-run set and lowers the comfort target.
_sensor_map_comment: Per-room temperature sensor entity IDs (or omit a room to use outdoor + heuristic).
_inverter_comment: Solar / battery sensor entity IDs. These names come from whatever integration exposes your inverter; substitute yours.
_battery_capacity_comment: Bank capacity used for time-to-empty math. Example: 840Ah at 51.2V nominal LFP = ~43 kWh.
